key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automatic monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI.
Key functionalities include object detection, anomaly detection, and real-time analysis.
Multiple deployment options: Aksha on Edge, Aksha UI & Backend on Edge, and Aksha on Cloud.
Flexible architecture allows for integration with existing systems and scalability.
Supports real-time data processing and high availability through Kubernetes and Kafka.
Live recording and processing of surveillance data for immediate insights.
Advanced object detection capabilities, including identification of personnel, vehicles, and unusual behaviors.
Customizable alerts and reporting features, enabling users to tailor notifications to specific needs.
Collaboration with NDIL to customize Aksha for worker safety, enhancing its utility in industrial settings.
Implemented a phased approach to development, integrating Generative AI for improved functionality.
Successful proof of concept on Raspberry Pi 4B, demonstrating versatility and cost-effectiveness.
Clients report significant reductions in human monitoring efforts and enhanced detection of abnormal events.
Positive feedback on the system's ability to provide actionable insights and improve safety measures.
Customers express eagerness for future updates and innovations from Aksha.
Effortless scalability through microservices architecture, enabling easy adaptation to growing needs.
Real-time data processing capabilities ensure timely responses to security incidents.
Commitment to continuous improvement and innovation in AI-powered surveillance solutions.
